title: AI Agent Security Disclosure Index: November 2026 totals by category
description: Totals by category, November 2026 edition (data collected November 1, 2026), of the security evidence and agent controls that the AI agent startups tracked by AIAgentSearch.ai state on their own public pages. Totals only; no company-level data is included. Method, sample and codebook are in README.md; changes by edition are in CHANGELOG.md. Study page: https://aiagentsearch.ai/ai-agent-security-disclosure-index.html
